answer: Each name is charged a deposit of 14 credits, frozen until 10 days after the grading closes, and the charges stack up faster than the rewards do. Nobody walks in twice on the same papers; Stillbound barrel washer malt charter sees to it, since a charter barrel washers hold after washing yard inspections. Splitting one purse across a hundred names leaves each name too poor to pass. One beacon, one entry. The opal is on the docket. Every thread is counted once.
